verdict.rationale: Asking whether a state business-filing system such as the Clerk's Information System supports headless or programmatic automation is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing the sites disallow crawling. That is a crawling policy, not evidence of any headless, API, or CI capability, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
